parcels.query: SELECT RELEASE, RELEASE_DT, VARIANT, BOROUGH_PARTITION, SOURCE_ROW_NUMBER, BBL, ADDRESS, BLDGCLASS, LANDUSE, YEARBUILT, LOTAREA, BLDGAREA, NUMBLDGS, NUMFLOORS, OWNERNAME, GEOM_WKT, CENTROID_LON, CENTROID_LAT, GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_VERSION, TRANSFORM_EXECUTION_ID, TRANSFORM_DEFINITION_ID, GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_PART, SOURCE_FILENAME, SOURCE_GEOM_WKB_SHA256, GEOM_WGS84_SHA256, SOURCE_CRS_IDENTIFIER, ST_DISTANCE(TO_GEOGRAPHY(GEOM_WKT), ST_MAKEPOINT(-73.95734672002, 40.647862086767)) AS DISTANCE_M, ST_COVERS(TO_GEOGRAPHY(GEOM_WKT), ST_MAKEPOINT(-73.95734672002, 40.647862086767)) AS COVERS_GEOCODE FROM EDGAR_DB.SOURCE.NYC_DCP_MAPPLUTO_GEOM_V3_EXT WHERE RELEASE = '26v2' AND BOROUGH_PARTITION = 'bk' AND VARIANT = 'shoreline_clipped' AND BBOX_XMIN <= -73.9548 AND BBOX_XMAX >= -73.9599 AND BBOX_YMIN <= 40.6498 AND BBOX_YMAX >= 40.6459 AND ST_DWITHIN(TO_GEOGRAPHY(GEOM_WKT), ST_MAKEPOINT(-73.95734672002, 40.647862086767), 150) ORDER BY BBL, SOURCE_ROW_NUMBER LIMIT 200
